changes.before: Thus, paired-end ChIP was treated as read-1 tags with fixed 200-bp extension, not BAMPE fragments.
changes.after: ChIP reads were aligned as paired-end data. For peak calling, MACS2 used the first mate of each pair and an assumed fragment length of 200 bp, rather than fragment lengths inferred from both mates.
